title: `QuotasNoOp.reserve` and `QuotasNoOp.check_deltas` use wrong first-parameter names (`context`, `cls`) without `@staticmethod`/`@classmethod`
detail: Lines 524–536: `QuotasNoOp.reserve(context, ...)` has `context` where `self` should be; `QuotasNoOp.check_deltas(cls, ...)` has `cls` without a `@classmethod` decorator. As undecorated instance methods, Python passes the instance as the first positional argument. Any caller invoking `noop_instance.reserve(context, ...)` passes `noop_instance` into `context`, shifting all remaining arguments by one position. The TODO comments on both methods say they will be removed in version 2.0, but until removed they can cause subtle call-site failures. Suggested fix: either add `@staticmethod` / `@classmethod` decorators or rename the first parameter to `self`.
